title.narrative: Strengthening humanitarian response and reform for the wider humanitarian community

description.narrative: Technical support to the wider humanitarian community, strengthening humanitarian reform and improvements in the humanitarian architecture for Sudan. This includes the secondment of experts into UN agencies (e.g. OCHA) to deliver specific functions; and support to organisations providing contextual and conflict-sensitive analysis, recommendations, and training to humanitarian partners.
